phase2_exit.basis: P2-A through P2-S remain deterministic CI-gated security comparisons. This registry distinguishes controls used by the default API from reusable components and evaluation-only control-plane proofs.

runtime_status_definitions.default_api: The hardened control is directly composed into the default FastAPI runtime path relevant to the control.
runtime_status_definitions.component_only: A hardened reusable component exists and is regression-tested, but the corresponding optional feature or boundary is not composed into the default API path.
runtime_status_definitions.evaluation_only: The hardened control-plane primitive is proven by deterministic tests/evaluation but is not default application authority.

controls.title: Tenant-boundary RAG isolation
controls.security_property: Retrieval authority comes from the server-derived principal and hardened knowledge queries are tenant-filtered.
controls.phase3_action: Keep tenant derivation and query filters inside the consolidated runtime composition root.

controls.title: Indirect prompt injection capability boundary
controls.security_property: Retrieved content can influence language but cannot expand server-owned tool capability.
controls.phase3_action: Retain explicit host-owned capability policies at every untrusted-content boundary.

controls.title: MCP tool poisoning and shadowing
controls.security_property: MCP discovery metadata cannot override host-owned server/tool identity and dispatch bindings.
controls.phase3_action: Require the host registry before runtime configuration can enable external or dynamic MCP discovery.

controls.title: Credential termination and downstream brokering
controls.security_property: Inbound MCP bearer credentials terminate at the gateway and are never forwarded as downstream authority.
controls.phase3_action: Route future downstream integrations through the broker instead of direct synthetic stores.

controls.title: SSRF, DNS, and redirect revalidation
controls.security_property: Outbound fetches use exact host policy, public resolved addresses, redirect revalidation, and bounded transport.
controls.phase3_action: Make the hardened fetcher mandatory before browser or network features can be enabled.

controls.title: Durable memory is data, not authority
controls.security_property: Persisted memory cannot replace authenticated identity, tenant, role, or approval authority.
controls.phase3_action: Wire memory only through an explicit data-only interface if it becomes a default runtime feature.

controls.title: Agent loop and resource exhaustion limits
controls.security_property: Multi-step execution is bounded by server-owned step, model, tool, retry, byte, duplicate-call, and time budgets.
controls.phase3_action: Use the shared bounded execution policy before enabling general multi-step agents.

controls.title: Telemetry minimization and redaction
controls.security_property: Telemetry leaves the agent as typed allowlisted pseudonymized security events rather than raw sensitive objects.
controls.phase3_action: Preserve application-side minimization when replacing the in-memory telemetry sink.

controls.title: Malicious artifact handling
controls.security_property: Untrusted artifacts receive server-owned paths, passive handling, and bounded archive extraction.
controls.phase3_action: Require the hardened artifact service before adding artifact endpoints to the default API.

controls.title: Browser indirect prompt injection
controls.security_property: Webpage content remains untrusted data and cannot create tool authority; fetches stay behind the hardened network boundary.
controls.phase3_action: Promote browser support only as a read-only capability composed with P2-E and P2-B.

controls.title: Durable approval workflow restart safety
controls.security_property: Human review is server-bound, durable, and non-replayable across restart; completed approvals are not bearer capabilities.
controls.phase3_action: Keep approval/workflow binding as the sole resume authority in the consolidated high-impact path.

controls.title: Transactional outbox and idempotent synthetic effects
controls.security_property: Approval consumption and outbox creation are atomic and duplicate delivery cannot create a duplicate synthetic effect.
controls.phase3_action: Preserve server-derived idempotency while higher authorization fences are composed into the worker.

controls.title: Execution-time authorization revalidation
controls.security_property: The first synthetic effect revalidates current server-owned authorization atomically with effect insertion and durable denial.
controls.phase3_action: Use P2-M as the default-runtime floor while P2-N through P2-S are consolidated above it.

controls.title: Authorization freshness and version fencing
controls.security_property: Cached authorization is usable only when policy version and revocation epoch match authoritative state at the first effect.
controls.phase3_action: Integrate version-fenced freshness into the default high-impact effect worker.

controls.title: Authenticated authorization provenance
controls.security_property: Authorization evidence is signed for the exact issuer, audience, binding, validity window, signing key, and key epoch.
controls.phase3_action: Compose signed provenance and monotonic key-epoch validation into the default worker.

controls.title: Rollback-resistant trust anchor
controls.security_property: The first new effect requires signed authorization to match an independent monotonic control-plane generation.
controls.phase3_action: Make independent generation state part of the consolidated control-plane composition root.

controls.title: Crash-safe control-plane recovery
controls.security_property: Security mutations follow prepared/applied/active convergence and authorization fails closed while recovery is pending or generations disagree.
controls.phase3_action: Centralize covered security-state writes behind one crash-safe coordinator and recover before authorization issuance.

controls.title: Protected monotonic recovery checkpoint
controls.security_property: A protected generation and journal head outside the local rollback set fence obsolete but internally consistent local state.
controls.phase3_action: Inject the checkpoint authority behind an explicit protected-domain interface with fail-closed startup.

controls.title: Authenticated checkpoint history and equivocation detection
controls.security_property: Protected receipts are Ed25519-authenticated, predecessor-linked, and single-history pinned so forgery and equivocation fail closed.
controls.phase3_action: Make signed receipt verification and durable witness history part of the consolidated default high-impact boundary.

phase3_gaps.title: Default runtime stops at P2-M
phase3_gaps.risk: P2-N through P2-S are proven controls but are not yet the authority used by the default API high-impact effect path.
acceptance_criteria: The default approval-to-synthetic-effect path composes P2-N through P2-S above P2-L/P2-M.
Stale, forged, rollback-restored, and equivocated authority cases are rejected through default application wiring.
High-impact tools remain approval requests and synthetic local effects only.

phase3_gaps.title: Control-plane write-path exclusivity
phase3_gaps.risk: Future direct writes can violate generation, journal, checkpoint, and receipt-history invariants.
acceptance_criteria: One authoritative repository/coordinator owns covered subject, policy, signing-key, generation, checkpoint, and witness mutations.
Runtime modules cannot obtain direct mutation-capable stores that bypass the coordinator.
Negative tests prove bypass writes are unavailable or fail closed.

phase3_gaps.title: Protected authority trust-domain abstraction
phase3_gaps.risk: The checkpoint and witness are local SQLite proofs; colocating production state with rollback-restorable authority invalidates the independence claim.
acceptance_criteria: Checkpoint and witness dependencies are injected behind explicit interfaces with server-owned authority, audience, and key configuration.
Runtime startup rejects rollback-domain aliasing or missing protected authority.
The local deterministic implementation remains a documented lab adapter only.

phase3_gaps.title: Control-plane composition and startup recovery
phase3_gaps.risk: State, effect, anchor, checkpoint, and witness primitives do not yet have one default composition root that owns safe ordering and startup recovery.
acceptance_criteria: One composition root owns the high-impact control-plane stores and ordering relationships.
Crash recovery and protected-history validation finish before new authorization or first-effect execution is enabled.
Duplicate authority representations are removed or explicitly non-authoritative.

phase3_gaps.title: Feature promotion gates for component-only controls
phase3_gaps.risk: Optional features could later be enabled without their hardened Phase 2 boundary.
acceptance_criteria: External MCP discovery, network/browser access, artifact ingestion, durable memory, and general multi-step execution each require their hardened control at enablement.
The default API remains safe with optional features disabled.
